dogecoin.text: Moonshot Potential: We've seen it, Dogecoin can rocket up with the right spark. Whether it's a celebrity mention, new adoption news or just the community's passion, $DOGE has the potential to surprise us all over again.
Elon Musk's Shoutouts: When Elon tweets about Dogecoin, it's like the whole crypto world listens. His support has literally moved markets. Imagine what another tweet could do...
